主要内容: In April 2014, total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 288,000, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Employment gains were widespread, with significant increases in professional and business services, retail trade, food services and drinking places, and construction. Professional and business services added 75,000 jobs, while retail trade employment rose by 35,000. Construction employment grew by 32,000, with growth in heavy and civil engineering construction and residential building. Health care employment increased by 19,000, and mining added 10,000 jobs. The data, from the Current Employment Statistics (CES) program, are seasonally adjusted and preliminary for the most recent two months. These figures reflect continued job growth across various sectors, with notable contributions from professional services, retail, and construction.
